ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Access to Sensitive File Extensions
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects known sensitive file extensions accessed on a network share Note: Unmapped fields: RelativeTargetName

sequences.query: (event_id = 5145 AND (RelativeTargetName = RGX("\\\.bak$") OR RelativeTargetName = RGX("\\\.dmp$") OR RelativeTargetName = RGX("\\\.edb$") OR RelativeTargetName = RGX("\\\.kirbi$") OR RelativeTargetName = RGX("\\\.msg$") OR RelativeTargetName = RGX("\\\.nsf$") OR RelativeTargetName = RGX("\\\.nst$") OR RelativeTargetName = RGX("\\\.oab$") OR RelativeTargetName = RGX("\\\.ost$") OR RelativeTargetName = RGX("\\\.pst$") OR RelativeTargetName = RGX("\\\.rdp$") OR RelativeTargetName = RGX("\\\\groups\\\.xml$")))
